title: Paper title and byline: a bold sans title, a deck, a byline grid (authors left, affiliation and date stacked right) between two hairlines, a marker line and the abstract
use: The first screen of a research paper: title, who wrote it, where, when, and the abstract that opens the article. Authors take markers (* and a dagger) explained in the note line.

brand.default: 示例研究线索 · 可解释性

title_1.default: 价格序列小模型里的特征
title_1.note: title line 1; about 14 CJK characters at 66 units

title_2.default: 一份可解释性研究笔记

authors.default: 示例作者甲*†、示例作者乙*、示例作者丙†、示例作者丁、示例作者戊、示例作者己、示例作者庚、示例作者辛、示例作者壬、示例作者癸、示例作者子*、示例作者丑
authors.note: names with markers, wrapped to 3 lines

affiliation.default: 示例研究组 · 量化可解释性

note.default: * 核心贡献者　† 基础设施贡献者　数据与结论均为示例

abstract.default: 我们在一个合成的价格序列任务上训练两层小型 Transformer，用稀疏自编码器取出特征，再对一条输入追踪归因图。本页的数据全部是示例，用来演示论文版式与交互图，不构成真实实验结果。

relations: Title 66 units bold 700 black on two lines at x 96; deck 22 units in the 60% ink; the byline sits between two hairlines (y 430 and 662): authors 19 units in the 80% ink over three lines at the left, affiliation and date stacked in a 388-unit column at x 1116, each under a 13-unit tracked kicker in the 60% ink; the marker line is 15 units.
The abstract opens under the byline: a bold 17-unit lead-in at x 96 and 20-unit text at 1.7 line height starting at x 192.
decoration: The brand mark (three nodes and two edges), the hairlines and the margin guides are decoration; all text is slots.

provenance.corpus: research-paper kit (examples/circuits-paper-kit): our own original interactive paper page in the circuits-paper grammar; all copy, features and numbers are labelled samples
provenance.experiment: styles/circuits-paper/style.json provenance (three public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The reference papers' title block and byline container, re-set at card size with our own copy: a bold sans title, a hairline-bounded grid and the abstract opening the article.
measured: Byline: full-width band between two 10% black rules, kickers 9.6 px uppercase 50% ink, names 12.8 / 19.2 px, authors 570 px at the left, affiliation and date stacked 70 px apart in a 114 px column (scaled about 1.5x here).
Template: default and 50 seeds, both sizes, light and dark pass the static check.
